summary: One-call Winsock bootstrap: declares a local WSAData structure on the stack and returns the result of WSAStartup(0x101, &WSAData), i.e. a request for Winsock version 1.1. The caller's result value is the Winsock startup error/status code.

operations.description: Call WSAStartup with requested version 0x101 (Winsock 1.1) and a pointer to a local WSAData structure.
Return the WSAStartup result code (0 on success, nonzero Winsock error otherwise).
Invoked by sub_561BF0 (0x00561BF0) and MemoryObjectAllocator (0x00562B50) as part of network/allocator startup.

unresolved: Whether the returned WSAStartup status is checked by either caller is not evidenced in the packet.
Owner object identity is UNKNOWN; the function is a free-standing initializer with no this-object evidence.
The WSAData structure contents are discarded locally; no data is persisted.
